plain_text:
Eddie Green appears in 85 recordings across 2 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1941 to 1949. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Eddie Green most often in Duffy's Tavern and Columbia Workshop.

Characters credited here include Eddie the Waiter.
